Taxon.reasoning_relevance: Lists taxonomic names (genera/families) representing discrete biological classifications.

Mean.reasoning: Represents the average value of the measured trait.
Mean.reasoning_relevance: Represents the average body size (a continuous measurement) of the taxon.

SD.reasoning: Represents the Standard Deviation of the measurement.
SD.reasoning_relevance: Represents the standard deviation of the body size measurement.

CV.reasoning: Represents the Coefficient of Variation (a statistical measure).
CV.reasoning_relevance: Represents the coefficient of variation, a statistical measure of size variability.

Min.reasoning: Represents the minimum observed value (a statistical measure).
Min.reasoning_relevance: Represents the minimum measured body size for the taxon.

Max.reasoning: Represents the maximum observed value (a statistical measure).
Max.reasoning_relevance: Represents the maximum measured body size for the taxon.
